body.purpose: Default UI text, table cells, descriptions (14px).

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked eyebrows and column headers (12px).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action (generate, compute) — the only solid emerald button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#0E8A5F; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:14px; padding:8px 12px; border:none; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0A6E4A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0E8A5F; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Featured / lucky highlight only — Fortune Gold, never competes with primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#C8922B; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:14px; padding:8px 12px; border:none; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity:.9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #C8922B; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action; ink-muted text, warm-panel hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:transparent; color:#4C5550; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:14px; padding:8px 12px; border:none; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#F1ECE3; color:#1B2320; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #D6CEC0; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#1B2320; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:14px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #E4DED3; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#F1ECE3; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #D6CEC0; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field on pure surface; emerald focus border + ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:#FFFFFF; color:#1B2320; border:1px solid #E4DED3; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#6B736E; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#0E8A5F; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0E8A5F; } .ds-input:disabled { background:#F1ECE3; cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Chip (selected)
components.description: Selected / filtered snapshot — emerald mist fill (selection, not action).
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#E5F3EC; color:#0E8A5F; border:1px solid #0E8A5F; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip-selected:hover { background:#D8EBE0; }

components.name: Chip (default)
components.css: .ds-chip-default { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#4C5550; border:1px solid #E4DED3; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip-default:hover { background:#F1ECE3; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Elevated white surface with hairline warm border and soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid #E4DED3; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(27,35,32,0.06); padding:16px; } .ds-card--interactive { transition:box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-card--interactive:hover { box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(27,35,32,0.08); } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:#1B2320; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar link; active uses warm-panel + ink (never collides with primary button).
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; background:transparent; color:#4C5550; border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:#F1ECE3; color:#1B2320; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0E8A5F; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background:#F1ECE3; color:#1B2320; }

narrative.overview: Esmeralda Fortuna is a Colombian lottery-intelligence platform with a deliberate, slightly warm personality: trust and luck, led by a confident green. The product never sells a win — it explains the odds with calm clarity. The interface feels like a well-tended garden: ordered, legible, quietly optimistic, where the accent earns its presence rather than shouting. Surfaces carry a warm paper tint rather than clinical white-on-gray, which keeps long analysis sessions comfortable. The single green accent owns primary actions and current selection; a sparing gold appears only for lucky or featured moments. Status is always communicated with color and icon and text, because honesty about odds demands that nothing rides on color alone.
keyCharacteristics: Green-led, warm-neutral, trust-forward operate-mode product UI.
One confident accent (Lucido Emerald) used with discipline; gold reserved for featured/lucky.
Every surface is warm-tinted; pure white appears only as an elevated card.
Status is multi-coded (color + icon + text), never color-only.
Familiar component vocabulary; consistency across screens is the virtue.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lucido Emerald owns ≤10% of any screen and is used for primary actions and current selection only. Its rarity is the point; scattering it dilutes trust.

rules.name: The Honest Status Rule
rules.body: Every status uses color + icon + text, never color alone. A red error with no label, or a green success with no words, is not allowed.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: All surfaces carry a warm paper tint (Warm Paper / Warm Panel); pure white appears only as an elevated card, never as a page background.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: A single sans (Inter) serves display, body, and label. Do not introduce a second typeface for product UI.

rules.name: The Readable Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is Ink Muted on light surfaces. Ink Faint is for non-essential text on white only; on Warm Panel it falls below 4.5:1, so promote it to Ink Muted there.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus ring), never as constant decoration.

dos: Do use Lucido Emerald for primary actions and current selection only (The One Accent Rule).
Do communicate every status with color + icon + text (The Honest Status Rule).
Do keep all surfaces warm-tinted; use pure white only for elevated cards.
Do use Warm Panel for the active nav item, not emerald.
Do promote secondary text on Warm Panel to Ink Muted to stay ≥4.5:1.
donts: Don't use blue (the legacy accent) for actions or selection — emerald owns those roles now.
Don't turn a selected/filter chip into a solid emerald button; selection uses Emerald Mist, action uses solid emerald.
Don't put Ink Faint (#6B736E) on Warm Panel — it fails WCAG AA body contrast.
Don't overload Fortune Gold; it is a rare featured/lucky highlight, not a second action color.
Don't invent radii outside the 6/10/16px scale.
